task: SingleFlight<K,V>: coalesce concurrent calls per key into one execution
reasoning_summary: A map of in-flight shared futures guarded by one lock; the first caller per key is leader and schedules the task. The key is removed before the shared future completes so continuations can start a fresh flight, and each caller gets future.copy() so cancellation is isolated. Passed on attempt 2 after fixing a test barrier/pool size defect.
